senses.gloss: a. Increasing, rising; तौ हि मूलमुदेष्यन्त्या जिगीषोरात्मसम्पदः [[Śi. 2. 76.]]
P. [उद्--आ--इ II. P.] To go up, rise, arise from, come up; [[Rv. 6. 51. 1]]; स ह प्रातः सभाग उदेयाय [[Ch. Up. 5. 3. 6.]]
a. Produced, originated, born; सख उदेयिवान्सात्वतां कुले [[Bhāg. 10. 31. 4.]]

a. Shaking, causing to tremble, terrifying; उदेजयान् भूतगणान् न्यषेधीत् [[Bk. 1. 15.]] 
-या f. Perturbance; न तं पश्यामि यस्यासौ भवेन् नोदेजया मतेः [[Bk. 5. 21.]]

__1 Pointing to or at, directing; सूर्योद्देशेन तिला दातव्याः [[Pt. 2]] in the name of. 
__2 Mention, specification; सार्धप्रहरद्वयोद्देशे [[Pt. 5]]; स्वरसंस्कारोद्देशः [[Nir.]] 
__3 Illustration, explanation, exemplification. 
__4 Ascertainment, determination, inquiry, investigation, search. 
__5 A brief statement or account; एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो बिभूतेर्विस्तरो मया [[Bg. 10. 40]]; [[Mb. 8. 69. 54.]] 
__6 Assignment, allotment. 
__7 Stipulation, bargain. 
__8 Object, motive; कृतोद्देशः स बीभत्सुः [[Mb. 3. 158. 3.]] 
__9 A spot, region, place; अहो प्रवातसुभगोयमुद्देशः [[Ś. 3]]; [[M. 3]]; बन° a part of the forest. 
__10 Upper region, high position. 
__11 (In phil.) The enunciation of a thing by its name (which is to be further discussed and explained), the other two processes being लक्षण and परीक्षा. 
-Comp. 
-पदम् The term (or terms) which form the subject; नात्रैषा वचनव्यक्तिः ये यजमाना इत्युद्देशपदम्, ऋत्बिजः इति बिधेयपदम् । [[ŚB. on MS. 6. 6. 20.]]

a. Illustrative. 
-कः 
__1 An illustration, example. 
__2 An illustrator, a guide. 
__3 (In Math.) A question, problem; अत्रोद्देशकः (frequently occurring in Līlāvatī).
ind. Pointedly, distinctly; एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तः [[Bg. 10. 40.]]

pot. p. 
__1 To be illustrated or explained. 
__2 To be intended or aimed at. 
__3 That to which one refers or which one has in view. 
-श्यम् 
__1 The object in view, an incentive. 
__2 The subject of an assertion (opp. बिधेय); see the word अनुबाद्य also.

a. 
__1 Pointing out. 
__2 One who acts with a certain object in view.
